description: A checkout link to buy credits (pack) or start a plan (plan, 3-day trial) on Whop — for the human to open and pay once. No email or personal data is in the link. Packs: MICRO, STARTER, VALUE, MEGA. For a new customer, EPISODE is the first episode pack: 350 credits, enough for one 30-second Character Studio drama episode. AI-generated video. Credits do not expire while your account is active. One-time purchase, no renewal. First purchase 50% off the regular $6.99. A new account's first video can be free in the web app (one watermarked video per person, a daily cap of 20 shared by all accounts; not available through API keys or MCP), then EPISODE at $3.49 on a first purchase is the next step. After they pay, poll autoshort_get_credit_balance. If the owner enabled auto-recharge, use autoshort_buy_credits instead (no link). Free.
name: autoshort_get_buy_credits_url
